mapper.select: select id, title, duration_minutes, summary, created_at from custom_courses where user_id = #{userId} order by created_at desc, id desc
select exercise_id from custom_course_exercises where custom_course_id = #{courseId} order by sort_order
mapper.insert: insert into custom_courses(user_id, title, duration_minutes, summary) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{durationMinutes}, #{summary})
insert into custom_course_exercises(custom_course_id, exercise_id, sort_order) values (#{courseId}, #{exerciseId}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.delete: delete from custom_courses where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
